evaluation_only: Ground truth for the evaluation harness only; app code never reads it (CLAUDE.md §9.2).
written: 2026-11-06, before the first run; each expectation is derived from the corpus facts named in `basis` (access_matrix.csv, conflicts.json, documents_index.csv, eoffice/seed.json), not from system output.
purpose: The opposite of each touchpoint scenario: where the correct output is the reverse — no access, nothing to find, nothing wrong, an order still in force. Run through the sandbox HTTP API as the officer would see it. The sandbox has no OCR: scans (D01, D02, D09, D11, D13, D15, D16, D22) stay in review, so no expectation here depends on a scan's text.

vocabulary.same_as_unknown: status code and body (request_id removed) identical to the same call for a record that does not exist — never confirm existence (CLAUDE.md §4.7); with 'path', the same GET on that path instead (ADR-0014 documents)
vocabulary.never_docs: corpus documents whose canonical ID must not appear anywhere in the response
vocabulary.must_docs: corpus documents whose canonical ID must appear
vocabulary.flag_types: the exact set of flag types (implemented A/C/E/F only)
vocabulary.certain_flags: the exact set of flag types reported as certain
vocabulary.empty: response fields that must be empty lists
vocabulary.not_equals: response field → value it must not have
vocabulary.no_in_place_of: no listed order is marked as replacing a cited order
